A5Analogue

VCF

24 dB/octave low-pass filter

Voltage-controlled four-pole low-pass. Resonance goes all the way into self-oscillation and can be controlled by CV.

  • Cutoff from about 20 Hz to 20 kHz
  • BASS switch keeps level and low end at high resonance
  • CV input with attenuverter
